meta_title: W. Boldan & Son | Painter & Decorator Sheffield
meta_description: W. Boldan & Son Ltd brings 20+ years of professional painting and decorating to Sheffield and Rotherham. Interior and exterior work. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full exterior transformations, we deliver quality finishes on time and within budget across Sheffield and Rotherham.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full commercial project, we handle interior and exterior work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Feature walls, full room redecoration, and specialist finishes. We prep surfaces properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Fascia, soffits, doors, and timber cladding — all protected against Sheffield's weather. We use trade-grade finishes built to last.

services.title: Commercial & Office Decoration
services.desc: Professional redecorating for shops, offices, and industrial spaces. Flexible scheduling to minimise disruption to your business.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Precision hanging of standard and premium wallpapers, murals, and textured finishes. We match patterns perfectly and remove old paper cleanly.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, frames, and fitted furniture — stained, varnished, or painted to your exact specification.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Proper prep work is everything. We patch, fill, sand, and prime to ensure flawless, long-lasting results.

about_pullquote: We do the work we'd be proud to show our own families.
about_para_1: W. Boldan & Son Ltd was established over two decades ago by William Boldan, a tradesman committed to honest work and real craftsmanship. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, serving homes and businesses across Sheffield, Rotherham, and surrounding areas. Every member of the team brings years of hands-on experience and a genuine pride in the finish.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on reliability, fair pricing, and attention to detail. Our customers come back to us because we treat every job—whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial space—as if it's our own. We listen to what you want, explain the options clearly, and deliver exactly what we've promised, on time and within budget.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had William and his team round to redecorate the lounge and hallway. Excellent job from start to finish. They were tidy, professional, and the quality of the work is brilliant. Will definitely have them back when we do the kitchen. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior woodwork painted before winter. Got a quote within 24 hours, and they fitted us in quickly. No mess, no fuss, and the finish looks perfect. Really pleased with the whole experience. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Called them for a small decorating job and ended up asking for their advice on colour schemes. They know their stuff and genuinely care about getting it right. Done in two days, looks fantastic. Local business doing brilliant work.
reviews.author: James W.
